data.summary: Privacy masking is now wired into the investment page. A new usePrivacyMode hook reads the stored privacy flag and listens for the toggle event. Investment.jsx passes isPrivate to the entries table, the mobile cards, the forecast table, InvestmentGraphModal and ForecastGraphModal. The money cells use formatValueForPrivacy, and the percentage cells are untouched. The y-axis labels and tooltips in all three chart modals mask money only. Details.jsx also passes isPrivate to the combined forecast modal. The yellow Edit button now uses the muted and border tokens. I could not run npm test or npm run build, so none of this has been executed.
